d.ko: A casual healing rpg that takes players on a journey around the house from the perspective of a young girl, what does she do when she's home alone? What strange things will you come across in the process, and while exploring, perhaps... What other strange secrets might you discover?
d.en: A casual healing rpg that takes players on a journey around the house from the perspective of a young girl, what does she do when she's home alone? What strange things will you come across in the process, and while exploring, perhaps... What other strange secrets might you discover?
d.zh: “独自在家”是一款在家中探索的休闲治愈类 迷你像素剧情游戏，玩家将以小女孩的视角 在家中玩耍游荡，她一个人的时候会做些什么呢？在这过程中又会遇到些什么奇怪的故事，在探索的过程中，或许..你还能发现一些奇怪的秘密？
